The change that stopped this is commit `c21a7cbf` ("TRUNK-6683: Skip full-text search with drugs when a concept is provided (#6346)", author Ian, 2026-07-17). It makes the ConceptName full-text lookup run only when no concept is supplied.

**The fix** is in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java`, in `newDrugQuery` (lines 1574–1593). Before the commit, the check was `if (searchDrugConceptNames)`. It is now `if (searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null)`, with a comment explaining that a supplied concept skips the "relatively expensive concept-name full-text search" (line 1582–1583). When the lookup is skipped, `conceptIds` is an empty list and the Drug query runs without the concept-name boosts.

**Call path:** `ConceptService.getDrugs(String, Concept, boolean, boolean, boolean, Integer, Integer)` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ConceptServiceImpl.java` (line 1579–1581) delegates to `ConceptDAO.getDrugs` (declared at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/ConceptDAO.java`, line 476). The Hibernate implementation is `HibernateConceptDAO.getDrugs` at lines 1562–1572, which calls `newDrugQuery`. The service layer was not changed.

**Tests added by the same commit:**
- `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAOTest.java` (about lines 125–158): `getDrugs_shouldNotSearchConceptNamesWhenConceptIsSupplied` checks that a concept-name-only match is excluded when a concept is passed, and `getDrugs_shouldSearchConceptNamesWhenNoConceptIsSupplied` checks that the lookup still runs with `null` concept.
- `openmrs-core/api/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/include/HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml` (lines 46–50): adds concept 20 ("ZEBRACONCEPT") and its drug "Placebo-X" as fixtures.

I did not run the test suite; the evidence is from reading the diff and the current source.
